routine.title: OCC PR Review Queue and Weekly Quality Sweep
routine.monday_leg: On the Monday 09:00 ET leg only, after the normal sweep, run from the immutable merged collector checkout with COLLECTOR_SHA set to that merged commit and RUN_ISSUE set to the execution issue: /usr/local/bin/onecli run -- node tools/occ-fleet-cqe/src/collect.mjs --collector-sha "$COLLECTOR_SHA" --run-issue "$RUN_ISSUE" --repository-owner misterbusiness1 --output fleet-cqe-coverage.v1.json --summary fleet-cqe-coverage.md. Upload fleet-cqe-coverage.v1.json and fleet-cqe-coverage.md to the execution issue and retain both for 13 months. This collector is report-only. Rollback is invocation-only: remove this collector invocation from the Monday leg without deleting, disabling, or otherwise changing the existing routine; retain historical artifacts as audit evidence.

invocation.command: /usr/local/bin/onecli run -- node tools/occ-fleet-cqe/src/collect.mjs --collector-sha $COLLECTOR_SHA --run-issue $RUN_ISSUE --repository-owner misterbusiness1 --output fleet-cqe-coverage.v1.json --summary fleet-cqe-coverage.md
invocation.collector_sha_contract: COLLECTOR_SHA must be the immutable merged commit containing this collector

reversibility.routine_change: Remove only the collector invocation from the existing Monday quality-sweep leg; do not delete or disable the routine.
reversibility.source_change: Revert tools/occ-fleet-cqe/ in a later repository commit.
